_: THE PLACES A SENTENCE SENDS THE OWNER, AND THE WORDS THEY NEVER SEE. A sentence that names a place asks words.place(id) (taskuary/words.py, website/src/words.js) for its name and its link - never a path typed into the sentence, so a page that moves or is renamed is fixed here once. `href` is the link the canvas already opens (website/src/canvasLinks.js, appLinks.js); '' for a place that is on the screen and has no link of its own. `jargon` is every word a non-coder must never read in a line the app writes for them.

advice_none._: WHEN THE ADVISOR HAS NO LINE, IT SAYS SO (2026-10-19): each reason advisor.status answers {none: why} with is one plain sentence and one move the row lights - `next` is the row's Next, `ai` the place that connects one. "Thinking about this one..." then nothing read as broken. `nothing` says only that there is no suggestion - "Nothing here needs a move from you" told the owner to skip a chat question nobody had answered.

nothing.line: No suggestion on this one - the choice is yours.

quiet.line: Nothing to decide on this one - it is here to read.

no_actions.line: There is nothing to do on this one from here.

working.line: An agent is working on this - it says when it needs you.

off.line: Suggestions are switched off in Settings.

cap.line: No suggestion for a while - the Advisor has read as many items as it may this hour.

no_ai.line: Connect an AI to get a suggestion on each item

loose_ends._: WHAT FELL THROUGH, SAID ON ITS ROW (sweep.py, 2026-10-20): the daily check's one sentence for each way an item can sit where nothing will move it, and the reason under it (`_why`). {ref} is the task's TQ number, {who} the person, {gist} their words, {ago} how long ago.
loose_ends.unanswered: {who} asked "{gist}" {ago} - no answer, no task, nothing decided
loose_ends.unanswered_why: a person asked you this over {days} days ago and nothing has happened to it since
